subject: clang-format: set ColumnLimit to 0 and reformat (#1045)
reason: The change is a pure clang-format reformat: .clang-format's ColumnLimit is set to 0 and ~60 source files are mechanically rewrapped (whitespace after commas, macro line-continuation realignment, removal of clang-format off/on guards, re-indented string arrays with identical string contents). No tokens, literals, control flow, configs, or replies change, so there is no behavioral path for a scenario to exercise.
